metadata.title: Retro-Futuristic Light Burst and Wireframe Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy radial light burst emanating from a central wireframe focal point with a 1980s futuristic aesthetic.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition featuring a central, large-scale isometric wireframe structure that serves as the source for intense, multi-colored radial light rays. The rays transition from deep reds and oranges to vibrant blues and cyans against a dark, void-like background.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry centered on the wireframe structure
High contrast between glowing neon rays and dark background
Linear perspective created by converging light paths
Geometric rigidity of the wireframe vs. the fluid energy of the light
coreInvariants: Radial light rays must converge at a central point within the wireframe
Wireframe must have a glowing, translucent quality
Color palette must include a warm-to-cool gradient transition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A massive isometric wireframe occupies the center and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central point of the wireframe where the light rays converge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the outer edges along the radial rays toward the central glowing core.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, deep space in the upper corners and between the light rays.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant cyan and magenta light rays
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights at the light source
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value for the rays against a low value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with horizontal striations
letterConstructionRules: Letters are composed of horizontal segments or scan-lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal gaps between segments to mimic digital displays
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace or high-tech display fonts to match the digital aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the blocky, futuristic tech feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark background with a central isometric wireframe structure emitting intense radial light rays in cyan, magenta, and red.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add segmented, blocky sans-serif text in the top corners using a white fill with horizontal scan-line gaps.

verificationChecks: Are the light rays perfectly radial?
Is the wireframe isometric and glowing?
Does the text have horizontal segmentation?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector-like lines for the wireframe
Smooth color gradients in the light rays
High contrast between light and dark

postGenerationChecks: Check for radial symmetry of light rays
Verify the isometric perspective of the central object
Ensure the text is legible despite the segmentation
Confirm the color palette transitions smoothly from warm to cool
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central isometric wireframe with a radial light burst and segmented techno-typography for a consistent 80s futuristic look.
